newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to open nuclear plant tender on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to open nuclear plant tender on Tuesday.

text.p: Turkey will open a tender on Tuesday for its first nuclear power plant near the village of Akkuyu near the southern Turkish coastal town of Mersin, the state-owned power authority TEAS said in a statement.
TEAS said it would hold a press conference on Tuesday morning to announce the details of the tender which would be published in the official gazette.
Officials had earlier said the plant was expected to be built with a capacity of 1,200 MegaWatts (MW) or two equal units each having a capacity of 600 MW at an estimated total cost of $1.5 billion.
